summary.text: Maddison Glover is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 60 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Mark Schreiber.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a domestic violence advocate, wife, mother and college student whose priorities include public education, health care, veterans and rural communities.

paragraphs.text: Maddison Glover earned a high school diploma from Madison High School and an associate degree from Butler Community College in 2023, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working in advocacy.
In her survey responses she described herself as a wife, a mother, a domestic violence advocate, a full-time employee and a college student.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 60 on August 4, 2026.
Glover said she decided to run because she wants a representative who is accessible, transparent and willing to listen to constituents.
Among her stated priorities are strengthening public education, expanding access to health care, supporting veterans, creating good-paying jobs and protecting rural communities.
She also listed improving non-emergency transportation for veterans in rural areas and responsible development of artificial intelligence and data centers among her policy interests.
